figures.alt: White French doors with an even reveal opening to a shaded Florida porch
figures.caption: A French-door pair depends on both leaves sharing the same reveal. Check hinges, frame movement, threshold, and the meeting edge before adjusting the strike.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: French-door hinges with snug screws and an even gap between door leaves
figures.caption: Resetting a loose hinge screw or adding sound backing can correct alignment. Keep hinge leaves seated flat and the jamb plumb before changing latch hardware.

figures.alt: Straight interior door casing and jamb reveal in a finished room
figures.caption: If the doors still will not latch, check for movement in the opening or wall above it before forcing the hardware into a new position.
